violation_type.title: Definition of Use Zone (26 TAC §747.4601)
violation_type.typical_finding: Play equipment in the backyard did not meet the use zone requirements.

finding_variants.text: Play equipment in the backyard did not meet the use zone requirements.

The Fisher Price climber did not have a 6 ft use zone around the climber.  There were metal push trucks and a Little Tykes rocker adjacent to the unit.  The unit was also 3 1/2 ft from the fence.    NOTE:  The unit was moved to proved the required use zone distance during the inspection.
